title: Classic Greek Salad
description: A vibrant, refreshing salad from the Mediterranean with ripe tomatoes, cucumbers, Kalamata olives, and a generous slab of feta cheese.
ingredients: 4 large ripe tomatoes, cut into wedges
Salt and freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Combine tomatoes, cucumbers, red onion, green pepper, and olives in a large bowl.
Whisk together olive oil, red wine vinegar, salt, and pepper to make the dressing.
Pour dressing over the vegetables and toss gently.
Place the whole block of feta on top — do not crumble it.
Drizzle a little extra olive oil over the feta.
Let rest 5 minutes to allow flavors to meld before serving.
author: Chef Nikos
